the_premise_was_partly_my_own_error.what_5zzzr_reported: market-view >300s and runtime ~23s, on BOTH cold and warm calls, therefore not warm-up
the_premise_was_partly_my_own_error.what_was_actually_true: the two 'warm' runtime readings were taken while an abandoned cold market-view request was still executing server-side. They measured contention, not the endpoint
the_premise_was_partly_my_own_error.consequence: the 'not just warmup' half of the premise was wrong, and it was mine
the_premise_was_partly_my_own_error.how_it_was_caught: a clean repeated baseline on a quiet machine returned 1.20s and 1.77s medians - nothing like 23s

contention_experiment.abandoned_request_then_poll: no effect - hypothesis REJECTED, the abandoned request had already finished
contention_experiment.server_is_threaded_but_gil_bound: 3 concurrent runtime calls = 3.42s wall vs 1.77s single

root_cause.primary: the market-view reconstruction was computed INLINE on a cold cache miss. `futures/_validated_core._swing_cache` makes 11,410 `resample_5m` calls - a full-history 5-minute resample per instrument - measured at 100.6s of a 127s profiled cold build
root_cause.why_it_is_cold_only: `_swing_cache` is keyed on `id(df)`, so a fresh process recomputes everything and a warm one hits the cache
root_cause.it_blocked_the_whole_payload: every other sleeve, the regime block and the levels note waited behind a panel they do not depend on
root_cause.it_was_a_documented_deliberate_trade: the code said 'Pay once rather than show an empty panel on first load'. That is design intent, not residue - so it was changed deliberately and the reasoning is recorded beside it, not silently reversed

changes.what: _recon_cached no longer computes inline on a cold miss
changes.how: spawns the same background worker the aged-out branch already used, claims the key under the lock so a polled endpoint starts ONE worker
changes.caller: renders an explicit warming state naming why, never a value

changes.why: 'still computing' and 'computed and it raised' are different facts; collapsing them is how an empty panel comes to mean either

changes.what: calm phases deferred through the same path

changes.invalidation_unchanged: the mtime key is kept EXACTLY as it was - only WHEN it is computed changed, never WHAT invalidates it. A TTL here was considered and rejected upstream

measurements_after.http_cold_note: the runtime cold reading was taken while the market-view warm-up workers were saturating the CPU - it is contention, the same effect that produced the 5ZZZ-R numbers, and it is labelled here rather than presented as the endpoint's own cost

a_bug_i_introduced_and_an_existing_test_.what: the stress branch ignored an explicitly-named `now`, so a caller that asked for a specific instant got the deferred warming state instead of that instant computed
a_bug_i_introduced_and_an_existing_test_.why_it_matters: the convention it broke is the route's own: a caller that names an instant gets that instant computed; only the live path is cached

did_any_data_become_unavailable.warm: NO - payload compared key-by-key against the pre-fix capture: 0 keys lost, 0 keys added, and every sleeve status identical (no_setup / missing_bars / no_setup)
did_any_data_become_unavailable.cold_window_only: during warm-up the deferred panels report status not_available with a sentence saying it is still computing and will fill in. No value is invented and nothing reads as a PASS
did_any_data_become_unavailable.swing_regime_basis_still_shown: previous session (lag 1), for both swing and NKD

track1_runtime_warm_1_99s.dominant_cost: the order gate's wiring scan: 160 `ast.parse` calls and 382,088 `ast.walk` calls per request, 1.85s, because `_gates()` runs `as_ledger()` and `may_enable_orders()` and each re-measures every blocker
track1_runtime_warm_1_99s.why_not_fixed_here: it lives in `global_index/track1_gates.py`, a runtime trading file this stage may not edit
track1_runtime_warm_1_99s.why_not_cached_dashboard_side: that would serve a SAFETY display stale, and deriving orders_possible from the ledger myself would be recomputing a gate differently from the slot code - explicitly not acceptable
track1_runtime_warm_1_99s.the_correct_fix_needs_authorisation: memoise `_identifiers` on (path, mtime, size). It is a pure function of file content, so this is behaviour-preserving, and it would speed up every gate consumer, not just the dashboard

not_fixed_and_why.remaining_cold_cost: stress daily_slices and bar slicing still run in the background; the machine is busy ~90s after a backend restart. That is the computation's real cost, not a request-path bug

mutation_list: cold miss computed inline (the old behaviour)
no single-worker guard (one worker per poll)
background worker never writes the value

the_five_failures_are_pre_existing_and_i.how: the three in 5ZZZ-B were re-run with the PRE-STAGE inline behaviour restored at runtime by monkeypatch - they fail there too, so this stage did not cause them
the_two_in_5ZZP_are_stale: test_the_regime_probe_is_still_recorded_not_computed_per_request forbids the name `label_regimes` in the module, but Stage 5ZZQ deliberately added it WITH an mtime cache - the later stage superseded the earlier rule

test_the_unwired_sleeves_say_so_rather_than_showing_nothing expects NOT_COMPUTED_UNTIL_ENTRY for global_nkd and roska4_swing, but Stage 5ZZZ-B wired those two sleeves, so that branch is unreachable for them
the_five_failures_are_pre_existing_and_i.left_failing_not_re_pinned: re-pinning asserts the new values are correct, which is the operator's call - same rule followed in 5ZZZ-R

a_helper_added_that_did_not_fix_what_i_e.what: warm(root) - builds until the deferred panels have landed
a_helper_added_that_did_not_fix_what_i_e.intended_for: tests and offline callers; the request path must never call it
a_helper_added_that_did_not_fix_what_i_e.honest_note: I added it believing it would fix the three 5ZZZ-B failures. It did not - those were pre-existing. It is kept because the deferral is real and a cold process would otherwise make those assertions flaky, but it costs test runtime and fixed nothing

tests.a_test_failed_first_run_for_a_real_reaso: the fill test raced its own stub: a reader that returns instantly can finish before the caller re-reads the cache. The stub now sleeps

backend_restart.why: the running backend had the old module loaded; a read-only dashboard fix cannot be served without replacing that process
backend_restart.scheduler: UNTOUCHED - ops printed it explicitly each time

safety.broker_connection_note: the backend holds one persistent read-only IBKR connection to port 4002, established at startup by a different reader. 20 polls created no new connection and spawned no child process
